content: Overall security score: 78/100. Strengths: MFA enforced, encryption at rest, regular pentests. title: API Documentation v2.md

title: Incident Response Playbook.pdf
content: Step-by-step IR procedures: 1) Identify and classify the incident. 2) Assemble response team (Security, Legal, Comms). 3) Contain and isolate. 4) Collect evidence. 5) Eradicate threat. 6) Recover. 7) Post-incident review. Contact tree and escalation matrix included.

title: Onboarding Checklist for New Hires.pdf
content: Day 1: laptop setup, email, Slack, VPN. Week 1: meet team, codebase access, dev environment setup. Week 2: first small task assigned. 30 days: check-in with manager. 60 days: first PR merged. 90 days: performance review.

title: Penetration Test Report October 2026.pdf
content: Full pentest report by external firm SecureWorks. Findings: 1 critical (SQL injection in /search - patched), 2 high (stored XSS in profile bio, no rate limit on /reset-password), 3 medium (verbose errors, missing CSP, outdated jQuery 3.4.1). All high findings remediated. Medium findings in progress.
